reviewMethod: Full Bengali and Burmese own-unit comparison directly against canonical Japanese during authoring and final self-review, without reading other locale pairs. No external translation service.
semanticChecks: 190: optical/electrical signal medium, mechanical support and equipment power kept separate; diagram description does not establish installation or energization.

191: core/cladding optical roles and refractive index versus protective coating; no all-layer material or mandatory-nylon assumption;20/100/400fibers distinct from cable diameter and fiber-core number; no bend-radius or cleaning instructions added.

192: metal broad category versus coax/twisted pair; outer conductor distinct from sheath; UTP lacks shield, no universal price/flexibility ranking; category not entire communication-system speed or completion.

193: messenger support does not mean zero cable load; integrated self-support still needs installation/design compatibility; payout device distinct from route guiding pulley/roller; selection is not authorization to start laying.

194: closure includes overhead and underground applications; external position not internal-fiber confirmation; gripping versus tensioning distinguished without requiring two separate products; no live-line/high-place operating procedure.

195: rectification ACtoDC versus battery storage; charging versus discharge; backup conditional on load/capacity/state and not unlimited runtime; model match not total supply-health or operation approval.

196: fusion of fiber connection distinct from melting cable sheath; mechanical splice/connector alternatives; sleeve compatibility not connection quality; holder versus coating-removal tool; connection existence not low-loss or good transmission evidence.
